cross_check_vs_amanatar.verdict: BIT-IDENTICAL to 16 decimal places on all three shared rows. The harvested third-party table genuinely described our pipeline, which validates the whole zero-cost recon approach.

structural_finding.claim: The 15-candidate "pruning family" is really ONE binary switch, not 15 knobs.
structural_finding.evidence: ep010, ep015, ep020, ep_cx and prune_pack are bit-identical in EVERY field: adjusted_edge_jaccard 0.9391861967544098, spurious_pred_nodes 174790, missed_gt_nodes 99. So (i) the OUTPUT_MIN_EDGE_PROB magnitude between 0.10 and 0.20 has ZERO effect - only on-vs-off matters, the edge probabilities must be bimodal with nothing in that interval; and (ii) stacking cx06 + leaf030 + seg035L4 on top of ep015 adds NOTHING.
structural_finding.consequence: There is no threshold to tune and no stack to assemble. The entire family collapses to the single +0.005126 proxy effect that regresses -0.0084939 on the 44b6 embryo prefix and loses in 10 of the 36 test-shaped subsets. seg* is ~0 (18 of 36 subsets exactly unchanged), cx10 is exactly base, cx06 and seg_cx are slightly negative, and cx03 is +0.00115 which fails the +0.0015 bar.

result.division_result_extended: div_tp = 3 of 12 and div_fn = 9 for ALL 16 configurations, as for amanatar 14. The division term is untouchable from the pruning family as well.

gate_2.detail: All 15 eligible candidates measured. Best by aggregate is the ep/prune_pack group at +0.00236 test-reweighted, which fails condition (2) (10 of 36 subsets strictly negative, limit 3) and condition (3) (44b6 prefix regresses -0.0084939, limit -0.001). cx03 fails (1) at +0.00115. leaf030/leaf040/leaf_seg fail (1) and (2). seg*/cx10 are ~0. cx06/seg_cx are negative. Not even the MARGINAL band (4-9 negative subsets) is reached by anything.

notebook_own_selection.means: The notebook own prefix-guarded margin rule also rejected every candidate, independently agreeing with our Gate 2.

submission_decision.reason: Per the rule pre-registered in experiment.json BEFORE the run: the selection was "base", so submission.csv is byte-identical to submission_base.csv and to the parent exp_064 output. Submitting it is a guaranteed 0.953 for ZERO information and would spend one of ~25 remaining slots. NOT SUBMITTED.
submission_decision.what_a_submission_would_require: A Run 2 that FORCES the ep015 switch on, overriding both the notebook own guard and our Gate 2. That is the only remaining way to learn whether the +0.00236 test-reweighted proxy gain transfers to the Public LB. It would be a DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION to a pre-registered rejection, not an adopt, and it needs explicit user authorization. Cost ~0.3 GPU h + 1 slot.
